## Cross-reviewer concerns folded into implementer brief (non-blocking)

1. **CLAUDE.md summary sync** (3-of-5 reviewer consensus: Methodology Claude #1, Alternatives Claude #1, Alternatives Codex #1). The CLAUDE.md "CPU-only phases don't hold GPU pods" summary line (line 234) is the always-loaded surface where #658 actually misrouted — leave it untouched and a future planner re-hits the same bug at the summary layer. Add one clause pointing at the new compute-character axis (e.g. after the "run off-pod on the VM ... by default" sentence: "this is for cheap closed-form / sampling work; an iterative gradient-descent fit is GPU-worthy and routes to a GPU lane — planner.md §9 compute-character carve-out").
2. **`>50 GB + gradient-fit` cell prose** (Methodology Claude #2, Alternatives Codex #2). There is no turnkey "A100 + big disk" GCP intent — `cpu-bigmem` is `gpu_count=0`, and the GCP GPU intents (`lora-7b` → `a2-ultragpu-1g`, `eval`/`debug` → smaller lanes) don't auto-bundle a big disk. Phrase the cell as "GPU intent (`lora-7b` for full A100 / `eval` for smaller) sized via `--boot-disk-gb` for GCP, or RunPod GPU intent with `--volume`-sized storage" — don't imply a single intent already exists.
3. **Per-phase wall-time floor, not per-fit** (Methodology Claude #3). #658's `_fit_mlp_loco` is per-cell — each fit may be fast, but the LOCO loop is long. Key the ~15-30 min floor to the *phase wall-time*, not the per-fit time, so a many-cell loop of individually-fast gradient fits still routes correctly to a GPU lane.
4. **Title-line length is cosmetic** (Methodology Claude #4). The plan extends item 10's title to three axes; if it gets unwieldy, drop the third axis from the title and let sub-clause (iii)'s bold lead-in carry it.
5. **Framing (C) was raised as preferable to (B)** (Alternatives Claude #2). The plan adds a NEW orthogonal carve-out (B); framing (C) — rewrite the OFF-POD default's *trigger* from "CPU-only" to "cheap closed-form / sampling-based CPU work" — removes the misleading "CPU-only" label at the source. Implementer's call: stay with (B) per plan or switch to (C). Framing (C) is structurally cleaner per the alternatives critic, but (B) is what the plan was approved on.
